what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Senegal in Spain: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3930 Senegalese asylum seekers in Spain, 10.1% of all asylum seekers from Senegal.
Refugees from Senegal, a separate group, live mostly in France, Gambia, Canada and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Casamance territory in Senegal with the MFDC in 2011.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2024 and 2025, come long after that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 32 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 6770, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Spain only.
